covered: Created a 4-player game from the first screen: Creuss, Hacan, Argent, Deepwrought, PoK and TE on, a pasted Milty map with the gate 17 at seat 1. Start numbers asserted: resources 4, influence 2, tokens 3/3/2, commodities 0.
Strategy cards: Trade main / Technology second (R1), Technology / Politics (R2), Trade / Technology (R3). Trade primary: +3 trade goods, commodities replenished to 4, and to 6 with Dynamis Core.

Research through the Technology card: Antimass Deflectors free, Wormhole Generator for 6 (paid Creuss 4 + 2 trade goods; needs Gravity Drive + Antimass); Carrier II (unit upgrade) + Neural Motivator; Plasma Scoring + Dimensional Splicer (red prerequisite). Negative check: Integrated Economy gives prerequisitesMissing (cybernetic x3).
Warfare secondary: production at the off-map home 51 (2 fighters for 1 trade good, strategy token 2->1).

Tactical action 1: route Quann(beta) -> 40 (beta) -> Vefut II; Slipstream gives carrier and flagship move 1 two hexes with no speedShort; pick-up of 2 infantry on the way; cargo 6 of 7; landing of 5 infantry and a mech; fleet-pool warning 4 ships vs 3.
Tactical action 2: ships out of a system that holds my command token (warning), space combat with losses of mine and of Hacan, landing on Lodor.

Tactical action in R2 by a two-tap jump 26(alpha) -> 39(alpha) under Quantum Entanglement; Emissary Taivra (agent) and Sai Seravus (commander) named in Used: commander placed a fighter in 39; second use of the agent warns componentExhausted; the agent is ready again in R3.

Wormhole Generator as a component action (alpha token into Vefut II); Ghost Ship (action card; a non-wormhole system gives ghostShipSystem); Mining Initiative (+3 trade goods); Riftwalker Meian hero (reminder, second use componentNotHeld); Icarus Drive mech named in Used (token beta); Dynamis Core relic action (+6 trade goods); Upgrade card played in Used (cruiser -> dreadnought).
Particle Synthesis (breakthrough) added in the components drawer; production in a wormhole system with the dock built by the Construction secondary (4 cruisers/3 cruisers).
Leaders states in the drawer (commander and hero unlocked by hand, agent exhausted/hero purged shown as 'set by the plan').
Creuss IFF given to Hacan in a transaction (with 2 commodities; 'not a neighbour' warning), then played by Hacan as a rival component action.

Rival actions: Hacan tactical action takes Lodor (my dock destroyed, my forecast resources fall 9 -> 6 at the status), Argent strategy card (my numbers unchanged), speedShort warning on the rival's own action.

Status entries x3: tokens, objectives scored (Expand Borders warns 2 of 6; Become the Gatekeeper; Diversify Research with no warning), action cards taken (Sabotage, Industrial and Economic Initiative, Upgrade), VP 3 at the end; agenda entry with Wormhole Reconstruction standing among the laws.
Forecast and Now modes read; Now mode shows no arrows; screenshots r1-*, r2-*, r3-* in test-results/scenarios/ghost; no page or console errors in any of the 41 steps.

findings.title: The Creuss start fleet cannot be routed out of the off-map home 51: the home has no hex
findings.repro: New game as Ghosts of Creuss, start. Add action > Tactical action, tap Tar'mann, Add source, tap tile 17 (gate), tap Tar'mann. The flight editor says 'No ships here.' / 'Nothing to take'. Tile 51 is not on the map (no 'Tile 51' button) and not an 'Add source' option; its units show only inside the home-production dialog of a Warfare entry.
findings.expected: LRR 6 note 2 / Creuss Gate: the home system (tile 51) is joined to the gate by the delta wormhole; the start carrier, 2 destroyers, 2 fighters and 4 infantry sit there and leave through the gate on the first tactical action.
findings.actual: The start units are held in state slot '51', which the route graph knows (src/domain/movement.ts boardSlots/offMapHomes) but no UI element can start a route from; the fleet can only be produced at, never moved from. The scenario sets the fleet up by hand on Quann.
findings.evidence: tests/scenarios/ghost.spec.ts step r1_04b_nosource and r1_00_setup (tile(51) count 0); src/ui never calls boardSlots/offMapHomes (grep).

findings.title: Payment block says 'Cost 6' but the check uses 5 with Particle Synthesis
findings.repro: Hold Particle Synthesis (drawer > Faction > search 'particle synthesis' > Add). Tactical action with active system Lodor (alpha wormhole, own space dock), Production: 3 Cruisers. Block reads 'Cost 6, paid 6' and the shop 'Cost / resources available 6 / 6'. Choose manually, remove one trade good: 'Cost 6, paid 5' and no warning. With nothing paid the warning reads 'need 5, paid 0, short by 5'.
findings.expected: Particle Synthesis: combined cost of units produced in a system with a wormhole is reduced by 1 per wormhole: 6 - 1 = 5, shown everywhere.
findings.actual: Replay applies the reduction (costOf in src/domain/replay/production.ts:247-251) but the displayed cost comes from the un-reduced figure (cardCost / unitStats productionCost in the editor and the shop).
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r2_15_prod; src/domain/strategy.ts:141 cardCost does not pass systemId/wormholes.

findings.title: Start infantry stand in the space of the home, so home production reads 'over capacity'
findings.repro: Creuss game, Add action > Strategy > card 6 Warfare (secondary) > Production in the home system > buy 2 Fighters, close. Warning 'System Creuss is over capacity: 5 of 4.' The shop shows 'Load / capacity 4 / 4' already before buying.
findings.expected: Infantry start on the planet (Creuss), not in the space area; capacity 4 of the carrier holds only the fighters beyond the 3 the dock keeps (LRR space dock), so 4 fighters need no warning.
findings.actual: initialState puts all startUnits, infantry included, into systems[home] (src/domain/replay/state.ts:71) so 4 infantry count as load; likely true for every faction, seen here on Creuss.
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r1_04_warfare; screenshot s5-home-prod.png / s6-after.png.

findings.title: A Creuss wormhole token placed by Wormhole Generator, IFF or the mech is not drawn on the map
findings.repro: Component action > Wormhole Generator > Alpha > Vefut II > Done (or Creuss IFF, Icarus Drive). Look at tile 20 in Forecast.
findings.expected: The hex shows the alpha sign like tile 26 and 39 do, so the player sees the new adjacency and Slipstream start.
findings.actual: Tile 20 text stays '2/2 2 20', no wormhole sign; tile legend/caption unchanged. The entry itself is titled only 'Component action', without the component name (other entries read 'Strategy: Trade', 'Secondary: Warfare').
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r1_08_wg (BUG assertions); screenshot r1-09 / s16-after-wg.png.

findings.title: Icarus Drive 'System of the mech' offers 'Nothing to choose from' when the mech stands on a planet
findings.repro: Land a mech on Vefut II. Tactical action, Used > + Used > Icarus Drive > Beta.
findings.expected: The system of the mech (Vefut II) is offered, as the card removes a mech from the board.
findings.actual: The list is empty ('Nothing to choose from'); the effect only works through its fallback that finds a mech on a planet. options() in src/domain/effects/components/mech/ghost_mech.ts lists only state.systems, not state.ground.
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r2_16_mech; ghost_mech.ts options.

findings.title: Losses of another player written in a battle survive deleting the entry
findings.repro: Hacan has Fighter x2 at home 16. Tactical action, tap 16, Battle, tap 'Fighter x2 (The Emirates of Hacan)', close, Done, Delete the entry. Open a new tactical action on 16 > Battle: the stack is Fighter x1.
findings.expected: Deleting the entry undoes what it recorded (the product rule is that rival losses are not part of the action, but the player expects delete to restore).
findings.actual: The loss is stored in the board (enemy units), not in the entry, so it is permanent and invisible in the plan; the same happened with Hacan's fighter on Lodor, which then no longer blockaded the dock.
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r3_10_enemyloss.

findings.title: Rival home reads 'over capacity: 2 of 0' after its carriers leave, listed twice
findings.repro: Rival tab Hacan > Tactical action to Lodor, route 16 > 24 > 26, take 2 carriers, cruiser, 4 infantry, Fly: warning 'System Arretze / Hercant / Kamdorn is over capacity: 2 of 0.' appears twice in the list.
findings.expected: Hacan's two remaining fighters sit under its space dock (kept without capacity); one line at most.
findings.actual: The dock of the rival's home seems not counted in the capacity of the left stack, and the same warning shows in the source block and the result block.
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r2_19b_rival_land; screenshot r2-19-rival-landed.png.

findings.title: Printed text issues: missing stop in Politics, 'Creuss Iff' name
findings.repro: Strategy > Politics shows 'Draw 2 action cards Look at the top 2 cards of the agenda deck.' Promissory note appears as 'Creuss Iff' in pickers and the deal line.
findings.expected: 'Draw 2 action cards. Look at ...' and the card name 'Creuss IFF'.
findings.actual: No stop between the sentences; the data name is 'Creuss Iff'.
findings.evidence: ghost.spec.ts step r2_03_politics; src/data/packs/base.json (promissory:iff).

findings.title: Planet names of the Hacan home hex run together ('ArretzeKamdorn')
findings.repro: Open the plan map at 1180x820 and look at tile 16 (Arretze / Hercant / Kamdorn).
findings.expected: Labels of the planets separated.
findings.actual: Two labels touch and read as one word.
findings.evidence: screenshots r2-19-rival-landed.png / r3-09-now.png (tile 16).

findings.title: Flagship ability (Hil Colish, delta wormhole in its system, moves before or after other ships) is not modelled or hinted anywhere
findings.repro: Search the components drawer / reminders for the flagship; the Ghost flagship has no entry in the plan.
findings.expected: A reminder in the flight step.
findings.actual: Nothing; this matches CLAUDE.md ('flagship ability not in the catalog') but means one Ghost special unit has no interface presence.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components has no flagship effect; CLAUDE.md.

notCovered: The Creuss start fleet moving out of home 51 (impossible, finding 1); the Ghost flagship ability.
Particle Synthesis production limit with the wormhole counting as PRODUCTION 1 (needs ships in the system): only the cost figure was checked.
Slipstream from a system that holds only a Creuss token (Vefut II) was not distinguishable from base speed in the routes used.
Wormhole Research / Wormhole Reconstruction effects on the route graph after the law passes (law only entered and shown among laws).
Deepwrought and Argent rival components beyond one strategy-card entry; Thunder's Edge faction mechanics of the rivals.
Expedition, Leadership token purchase, Diplomacy, Imperial primary of my own; Gravity Drive waiver for a ship one hex short was not exercised.
No test was added to tests/e2e steady-controls for the new repeatable controls (out of scope).

covered: Created the 5-player game by clicking (Nekro vs Sol, Hacan, Argent, Last Bastion; PoK and TE on), pasted a Milty map with homes, checked the Nekro start: home Mordai II 4/0, 3 commodities, tokens 3/3/2, Dacxive Animators.

Played 3 rounds, 23 entries in action lists plus 3 status entries and 1 agenda entry (spec: tests/scenarios/nekro.spec.ts). Cards: Technology, Leadership, Imperial as mine; Politics, Trade, Diplomacy, Technology as secondaries.

Propagation: researching Valefar Assimilator X and Y and Sarween Tools gives 3 tokens each ('Distribute tokens'), no technology is held; the second research costs 6 (paid by 4 planet and 2 trade goods).

Tactical actions with routes, cargo, fleet pool, landing, a command-token block on the source, a battle with losses for me and for Sol, production at Mordai II paid by planets, over-limit warnings, a Sol transaction giving the faction note Antivirus, and moving out of a system with my token waived by the Dominus Orb (shown as 'Allowed by').

Agent Nekro Malleon: used with a token to give 2 trade goods; a second use in the same round warns that it is exhausted. Hero UNIT.DSGN.FLAYESH: unlocked in the drawer, played as a component action (trade goods from Vorhal added, Bastion units on the planet gone, hero purged). Commander unlocked by hand. Breakthrough Valefar Assimilator Z added by drawer search. Legendary planets Imperial Arms Vault (mech placed on Hope's End) and The Atrament (2 infantry on Mecatol).

General components: 5 non-faction technologies (blue, red, green, a unit upgrade, plus Sarween as research), action cards Mining Initiative and Economic Initiative played as component actions, Sabotage, Direct Hit and Skilled Retreat taken, relic Dominus Orb gained by purging three relic fragments, 4 objectives scored (public and secret), a law (Anti-Intellectual Revolution) shown in the drawer, Mecatol Rex taken with the custodians point, an Imperial point.

Totals asserted against my own count of the rules: final tactic 3, fleet 8, strategy 2, VP 6, commodities 3 after the Trade secondary, trade goods after each step; Sol holds Antivirus under 'Notes of other players' with the printed text.
Console and page errors watched for the whole game: none.

findings.title: A relic fragment's ACTION cannot be chosen as a component action
findings.repro: R3: Add action > Component action > search 'cultural relic fragment' (also 'fragment', 'cultural') while holding fragments taken in a tactical action.
findings.expected: LRR 73.1 and the card: 'ACTION: Purge 3 of your cultural relic fragments to gain 1 relic.' The effect file crf1.ts says it is played as a component action.
findings.actual: The picker shows 'Nothing found.' The component-action picker offers no exploration cards. The only way is to name the fragment in the 'Used' block of another entry. The spec asserts this.
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/editors/TurnEditor.tsx:23 PLAYED_KINDS has no 'exploration'; screenshot test-results/scenarios/nekro/r3-pick.png

findings.title: The Nekro hero cannot choose the technology it gains
findings.repro: R3: Component action > UNIT.DSGN.FLAYESH > pick a planet (Vorhal).
findings.expected: Hero text: 'gain 1 technology that matches the specialty of that planet'; the effect declares a 'technology' choice.
findings.actual: The choices block shows 'Nothing to choose from' for the technology. The trade goods of the planet (0+2) are applied, but the technology has to be added by hand in Took (done in the spec). The unit test is still a todo.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components/leader/nekrohero.ts:20 (choice kind 'component' with no options); nekrohero.ui.test.tsx is test.todo; screenshot r3-hero2.png

findings.title: The planet buttons of the hero's choice are cut off
findings.repro: R3: Component action > UNIT.DSGN.FLAYESH; look at the planet row in the plan panel.
findings.expected: All planet names readable, wrapped or scrollable as in the Atrament block (which wraps).
findings.actual: About 24 planets sit in one horizontal row inside the panel; 17 buttons have scrollWidth > clientWidth ('Thiba', 'Tar'm', 'New Albio', 'Arch Vail'). The spec asserts the count is above 0.
findings.evidence: test-results/scenarios/nekro/r3-hero2.png

findings.title: The top Resources/Influence totals ignore attached exploration cards
findings.repro: R2: tactical action to Primor, landing 2 infantry, Took and Used 'Dyson Sphere' (+2 resources, +1 influence for the planet). Follow the totals to the end of round 3.
findings.expected: Primor 4/2. At the end of round 3: resources 4 (Mordai II) + 3 (Hope's End) + 4 (Primor) + 1 (Mecatol) = 12 and influence 2 + 6 = 8.
findings.actual: The top line shows Resources 10 and Influence 7 (printed values). The payment block does value it ('Primor 4').
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/SummaryBar.tsx:20-23 calls readyResources(state, pack) with no view, so planetValue returns the printed value (src/domain/payment.ts:50)

findings.title: Mining Initiative ignores Dyson Sphere on the chosen planet
findings.repro: After Dyson Sphere is attached to Primor (the payment block proves it), play Mining Initiative as a component action and choose Primor.
findings.expected: Trade goods equal to the planet's resource value, 4 with the sphere (LRR/card text: 'resource value of 1 planet you control').
findings.actual: Trade goods rise by 2 (8 to 10). The spec asserts 10.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components/actionCard/mining_initiative.ts:24-25 reads the value with applied(...) and not appliedToPlanet, so the attached card is not counted

findings.title: Landing on Mecatol Rex always warns that 6 influence are short, and nothing can pay them
findings.repro: R3: tactical action to Mecatol Rex, land 2 infantry (the first to land removes the custodians token).
findings.expected: LRR 27.2: spend 6 influence to remove the custodians token. The interface should let me record the 6 influence, and the warning should clear.
findings.actual: Two warnings: the custodians note, and 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6.' No payment block exists in the landing, so the warning stays even with enough trade goods and influence.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:86 violation('shortInfluence', {needed: 6, paid: 0}); screenshot r3-tacF.png

findings.title: Trade goods an agent gives in an entry cannot pay for that same entry
findings.repro: Strategy entry (Technology): research Valefar X and Y, add Nekro Malleon in Used with token pay (2 trade goods), then pay for the 6-resource second research.
findings.expected: The agent is used during the action phase and may come before the card, so the 2 trade goods could pay.
findings.actual: The payment block says 'Not enough trade goods: need 1, have 0' and the shortage stays. The effect of Used is applied after the card's payment, so the order inside an entry is fixed.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/timeline.ts: applyCard (payment) runs before applyUses and the play effects

findings.title: The agenda entry says nothing of Galactic Threat ('You cannot vote on agendas')
findings.repro: R3: + Agenda for Nekro, open the editor.
findings.expected: The faction ability of the agenda phase shown as a reminder in the agenda step, as other abilities are in tactical steps.
findings.actual: No text about Galactic Threat or about the prediction in the editor. The effect is a hint with no step, so it appears only in the faction sheet. The spec asserts it is absent.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components/ability/galactic_threat.ts (tier hint, no hintAt)

findings.title: A component action entry in the list does not name its component
findings.repro: Play Mining Initiative as a component action; look at the entry in the Actions list.
findings.expected: A title that tells which card was played, as a tactical action names its system.
findings.actual: The row reads only 'Component action'.
findings.evidence: test-results/scenarios/nekro (R1 actions list; asserted in the spec)

findings.title: The agent's player choice has no 'me' button; me is an unmarked default
findings.repro: Used > Nekro Malleon: the Player row shows Sol, Hacan, Argent, Bastion and no button for the Nekro player.
findings.expected: A visible way to choose myself, since the agent may choose any player including its owner.
findings.actual: With nothing pressed the effect applies to me, which the screen does not say. Trade goods and the pool change as for me.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/choices.ts optionsOf for kind 'player' returns only opponents when the owner is me (play.test.ts:56)

notCovered: The flagship The Alastor and War Sun were never built or moved, so their ability text (ground forces joining the space combat) was not tried.

Valefar Assimilator X/Y: the app keeps no token, so only the Propagation replacement of research was checked, not the copied text. The Valefar Z breakthrough is only added in the drawer (the effect is a hint without a step).
The commander hint ('after you gain a technology, draw an action card') was not checked at the card step: the commander was unlocked in round 3 and I did not compare the hint block there.
Technological Singularity and Antivirus as a combat effect: only reminders exist, and technologies were entered by hand in Took.
Frontier exploration and attached cards other than Dyson Sphere, the Thunder's Edge expedition, rival plans in their own tabs and the Russian interface were not played.

Production by Warfare/Construction secondaries, upgrades of unit values in routes (Dreadnought II speed), and export/import, offline and the Now/Forecast toggle in depth were not covered. The arrows seen in Now mode were a short animation, so no finding was raised.

covered: Created the game by clicking: me = Embers of Muaat, rivals Sol, Naaz-Rokha, Hacan, Deepwrought, Letnev, PoK + Thunder's Edge on, Milty string pasted, home systems placed. Start totals asserted (res 4, inf 1, tactic 3, fleet 3, strategy 2).

Three rounds, 29 plan entries counted across the rounds (a few are rivals' or setup entries). Spec tests/scenarios/muaat.spec.ts, 3 serial tests, about 30 s total; 18 key screenshots in test-results/scenarios/muaat/ looked at.

R1: tactical action with war sun + 4 infantry + 2 fighters into Horizon (3 planets, landed 1/1/2); newly gained planets stay exhausted so Resources stay 4. Technology card primary: Dimensional Splicer; prerequisite warning for Prototype War Sun II (2 missing) and short-resources warning verified.

R1: Star Forge as a component action (fighters at the war sun, strategy 2 to 1); commander Magmus unlocked in the drawer afterwards gave a retroactive trade good; Trade secondary of another player (commodities 4, token spent, TG +1); home-system production (carrier + mech, cost 5, paid Muaat 4 + 1 TG); sourceActivated and routeBlocked (supernova without reactor) warnings stand.

R1 deals: Sol gets Fires of the Gashlai and commodities, I get Military Support and a trade good, a far-away neighbour warning shows. Sol (rival entry) plays Fires: my fleet 3 to 2, Sol gets the war sun technology, the note returns to me.
R1 pass took 3 action cards; status entry: tokens, Muaat point, objective Engineer a Marvel, action card.

R2: planets refresh (res 10, inf 4); Technology primary Sarween Tools + Magmus Reactor paid 6 by planets. Hacan cruisers set up at 43 and 62. War sun into supernova 43: routeBlocked struck through with Allowed by: Magmus Reactor; Production 5 in the supernova (productionOver at 6 fighters, gone at 4); capacity numbers right; hero Ba'al named in Used removed the Hacan cruiser at 43, kept the one at 62.

R2: Umbat agent used, second use warns componentExhausted; Star Forge twice (mech brings an infantry; second use warns shortStrategy, pool goes to -1, commander still pays TG); Mining Initiative (+3 TG); Sol's Military Support played from my hand (2 infantry); pass with a neighbour deal (no neighbour warning when units are adjacent); status with 2 tactic tokens.

R3: Technology gave Prototype War Sun II (no prerequisite warning) and Destroyer II (unit upgrade); war sun route 43-110-80-Mecatol with 3 steps, no speedShort, supernova on the way waived by Gashlai Physiology; pick-up of 2 infantry at Luthien VI on the way; Mecatol landing, battle losses recorded (mine fighter -1), custodians point; hero second play warns componentNotHeld.

R3: Dynamis Core relic taken and played (+6 TG); War Effort and Industrial Initiative as component actions, Economic Initiative in Used; home production flagship + 2 destroyers (cost 10), fleet-pool warning and the Excess ships flow; war sun cost 10 after the upgrade; Umbat ready again after the status phase; Antimass Deflectors and Neural Motivator taken (blue, green); pass with a deal getting my own note back; status with two public objectives (one-per-phase warning), Develop Weaponry and Achieve Supremacy; agenda entry with a law shown in the drawer; Now/Forecast toggle.
Console errors: none in the whole game.

findings.title: Production warning about blockading ships stays after the hero destroyed those ships
findings.repro: R2: Hacan cruiser set up in supernova 43 (Setup mode, owner Hacan). Tactical action, active system 43, war sun from 110, production of fighters in the shop. Add + Used > Adjudicator Ba'al. The cruiser disappears from the map, but the productionBlockaded warning in the Production block stays.
findings.expected: Hero text: after you move a war sun into a non-home system you may destroy all other players' units in that system. The ships are gone before production, so 'holds other players' ships: ships cannot be produced there' should not be shown (the warning is real only for the order production first, hero later).
findings.actual: Warning 'Supernova (43) holds other players' ships: by the rules ships cannot be produced there, ground forces can.' still standing in the entry row after Done. Asserted with a BUG comment in the spec.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/production.ts (blockade check) runs inside applyEntry, while the play of the hero runs after it, src/domain/replay/timeline.ts around lines 112-124; screenshot test-results/scenarios/muaat/11-hero-blockade-warning.png

findings.title: Umbat (and every 'choose a player' component) cannot choose the acting player
findings.repro: Add action > Component action > Umbat. The player row offers Sol, Naaz-Rokha, Hacan, Deepwrought, Letnev; there is no Muaat button.
findings.expected: Umbat: 'choose a player: that player may produce up to 2 units...'. Nothing says 'another player'; the Muaat normally chooses themselves.
findings.actual: Self is not offered. Also the production Umbat grants has no block anywhere in the editor and no hint text shows in the step (the agent only exhausts).
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/choices.ts:40 filters out ctx.player for kind 'player'; src/domain/effects/components/leader/muaatagent.ts says the production has no block yet. Spec asserts the absence with a BUG comment.

findings.title: The Quantumcore gives the breakthrough but Stellar Genesis does not run: Avernus is never gained
findings.repro: R3: Strategy entry > + Took > The Quantumcore. Open Components > Faction: the breakthrough Stellar Genesis shows. Summary Resources stay 4.
findings.expected: Quantumcore: 'gain your breakthrough'. Stellar Genesis: 'when you gain this card ... gain the Avernus planet card and ready it'. Avernus is 2/0: Resources should rise by 2 and the planet be mine.
findings.actual: Resources unchanged (4), no Avernus control. Besides that, a breakthrough cannot be gained any other way through the interface: the '+ Took' picker offers no breakthrough ('breakthrough' search finds only Brilliance and Quantumcore; 'stellar genesis' finds nothing), and the drawer only lists it.
findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components/relic/quantumcore.ts sets state.holdings.breakthrough = 'held' directly instead of going through the gain hook that src/domain/effects/components/breakthrough/muaatbt.ts (gained) hangs on. Spec step 'R3: a new round...' has the BUG comment.

findings.title: Custodians cost is warned as unpaid but the plan offers no way to pay it
findings.repro: R3: tactical action to Mecatol Rex, land infantry. Editor shows 'The custodians token is still on Mecatol Rex ... which the plan does not record' and also 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6.' No payment block exists in the landing block.
findings.expected: Either a way to pay 6 influence (planets exhausted) in the landing, or no shortInfluence warning (LRR 27.2: the first to land spends 6 influence).
findings.actual: Two warnings that can never be cleared, the entry stays marked as warned forever; planets are not exhausted by it and influence totals show 10 after the landing.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:84-86 pushes custodians and shortInfluence with paid: 0 always; screenshot test-results/scenarios/muaat/look-mec3.png

findings.title: Neighbour warning shows in a new transaction before any player is chosen
findings.repro: Any entry > + Transaction. Before touching the player row the text 'A transaction is only with a neighbour: you need units or planets in the same or adjacent systems.' is already shown under Give/Get.
findings.expected: No warning until a counterparty is chosen.
findings.actual: Orange warning with no player selected (it also stays for far players correctly, and is gone for a real neighbour).
findings.evidence: test-results/scenarios/muaat/look-deal1.png

findings.title: System choice of Star Forge and other 'system' choices is a 40-hex wide scrolling strip of names
findings.repro: Component action > Star Forge. The system row is one horizontal strip with every system of the map by planet names (tiles without planets by number); names like 'Arretze / Hercant / Kamdorn' wrap into narrow columns and the choice goes beyond the panel width.
findings.expected: A way to tap the system on the map (like the active-system choice) or at least search.
findings.actual: Scroll the strip; hard to find the war sun system.
findings.evidence: test-results/scenarios/muaat/look-forge.png

notCovered: Magmus reactor 'into supernova' route was only checked as the active system; Gashlai through-supernova, MR into-supernova and the standing warning without both were all covered, but asteroid or nebula on the route with Gashlai (must stay warned) was not drawn, because adjacency made the route too long for the spare tactic tokens.
Antimass Deflectors waiver was not exercised (taken only to have a blue technology); Neural Motivator's status effect not checked.

Production that Umbat grants and the hero's tile replacement cannot be entered (known: not modelled); Fires of the Gashlai play by a player who already owns the war sun upgrade (researchOwned) not tried.
Ember Colossus infantry-by-Star-Forge was checked on units on the map only (count of infantry stack), not the planet versus space placement.

findings.title: Automatic payment ignores the Sarween Tools discount: overpays and exhausts a planet that is not needed
findings.repro: Letnev holds Sarween Tools (research it in round 1 with the Technology card). Add a Tactical action on the home system 10, open Production, buy Cruiser x2 and Fighter x1, close the shop. The block says 'Cost 5, paid 6 ... Arc Prime 4, Wren Terra 2 ... Surplus 1 is lost'. With Arc Prime alone selected by hand the block says 'Cost 5, paid 4' and no warning. Later: 5 Destroyers also 'Cost 5, paid 5'; Flagship+Mech 'Cost 10, paid 10' (need 9).
findings.expected: Sarween Tools: 'When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.' The check already wants 4 ('Not enough resources: need 4, paid 0'), so the automatic payment should take 4 (Arc Prime alone), the header should show the reduced cost, and Resources after the action should be 2 (Wren Terra ready), not 0.
findings.actual: The header shows the undiscounted cost (5) and the automatic payment is seeded from it, taking both home planets (6); the shop warning (need 4) and the payment (5/6) disagree. The summary then shows 0 resources instead of 2.
findings.evidence: src/domain/tactical.ts:188 (autoPay seeded with productionCost without the 'productionCost' modify of src/domain/effects/components/technology/st.ts); screenshots 06b-a3.png, 40-d1.png; spec step 'twist: drop the paid second research' has the // BUG (F1) comment

findings.title: Mitosis places 2 infantry per round once a status entry exists

Look at tile 5: planet infantry shows 2 (1 landed + 1 Mitosis already projected with no status entry). Press 'Жетоны и очки' to add the status entry: Nestphar infantry becomes 3. findings.evidence: src/domain/effects/components/ability/mitosis.ts (onStatusStart) and src/domain/replay/timeline.ts:196-215 (startStatus/finishStatus); tests/scenarios/arborec.spec.ts R2 step 'E6 pass, the status entry' asserts the actual 9 with a // BUG comment

findings.repro: Hacan (Sarween Tools from the start). Tactical action on the home system 16, Production, buy a Cruiser and two Hercant infantry (printed 3). Look at the shop line 'Cost / resources available' and at the Payment block in the editor. Second case: name the unlocked hero Harrugh Gefhara in Used and buy Flagship plus two mechs.
findings.expected: Sarween Tools: 'reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1', so cost 2 and the auto payment takes 2 resources (the replay itself uses 2: manual payment of Arretze alone gives no shortResources). Hero: every unit costs 0, so the shop should read 0 of 10 and not flag a shortage.
findings.actual: Shop shows 3 / 6 and the Payment block 'Cost 3, paid 3', auto payment exhausts Arretze and Hercant (3 resources); unplugging Hercant by hand shows 'Cost 3, paid 2' with no warning. With the hero the shop shows 12 / 10 (over, in warning colour) while the entry owes nothing and has no payment block.
findings.evidence: tests/scenarios/hacan.spec.ts steps e3 and r3-e5 (// BUG). Cause: src/domain/tactical.ts:180-181 (withProduction seeds the payment from productionCost without the combined reduction) and src/ui/map/stage/useStage.ts:348 (counter uses productionCost); the replay uses costOf in src/domain/replay/production.ts:243.

findings.title: Technology specialty choice is lost on import and on a plain page reload
findings.repro: Round with Technology primary researching Neural Motivator and Production Biomes; in 'Technology specialties' tap New Albion (biotic) so the second biotic prerequisite is met. Export to file, delete the save, import the file: open the round. Or just reload the page.
findings.expected: Everything of the plan comes back identical; the exported file already holds effects.specialties:['newalbion'].
findings.actual: After import and after reload the specialty is gone: New Albion is not exhausted for the prerequisite, the row shows 'The prerequisites of Production Biomes are not met: 1 missing (biotic ×1).' and forecast resources/influence change 3->4 and 9->10. Re-export shows effects without specialties.
findings.evidence: Spec step 'twist' (// BUG). src/storage/schema.ts:28 area: the cardPlay `effects` zod object lists researched, payment, etc. but not `specialties` (src/domain/types.ts:266), so parsing strips it.

findings.title: A technology of another faction can be researched without any warning

findings.expected: LRR 90.10: a player gains the card from their own technology deck, so another faction's technology cannot be researched; at least a warning.
findings.actual: The picker offers them and the editor shows no warning, payment is taken, the technology joins my holdings.
findings.evidence: Spec step r2-e2 (// BUG), standing warnings count 0. src/domain/replay/research.ts checks only prerequisites (line ~117).

findings.title: The 6 influence of the custodians token cannot be paid; shortInfluence always stands
findings.repro: Tactical action to Mecatol Rex (tile 18), land infantry from a carrier.
findings.expected: LRR 27.2 / 54.1: ground forces land only after the custodians token is removed by spending 6 influence; the planner should let me pay (planets or trade goods) and then show no shortage.
findings.actual: Two warnings always stand: 'custodians ... removing it costs 6 influence, which the plan does not record' and 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6.' No influence or trade good is spent, so the numbers at the top ignore the cost, and the row stays warned however much I own. VP +1 is given.
findings.evidence: Spec r3-e4 (// BUG). src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:84-88 hard-codes paid: 0; no payment field exists in the landing block.

findings.title: Start ground forces stand in space, so carriers leaving the home system warn 'over capacity'

findings.actual: Start infantry are listed under the system's Space group ('Take one Infantry' under 16, and 'Land one Infantry: 4' on all three home planets when the home is activated). findings.title: Second use of an exhausted agent or a purged hero in Used is warned in the plan row but not in the editor

findings.title: Seat slot cannot be tapped, though the game screen tells me to place a home system there

findings.title: Top Resources/Influence totals ignore Nano-Forge (+2/+2) although payment counts it
findings.repro: Saar, round 4 (spec step 'Nano-Forge as a component action on Starpoint'): + Took Nano-Forge, Add action > Component action > Nano-Forge, pick planet Starpoint (3/1, ready). Read the Resources/Influence totals before and after (9 -> 8 / 5 -> 10 both times). Then Strategy > Technology secondary > Research Dark Energy Tap > Choose manually: the picker lists 'Starpoint 5'.
findings.expected: Nano-Forge text: 'its resource and influence values are increased by 2'. Ready resources/influence in the summary should rise to 10 and 12 (Starpoint 5/3), the same value the payment picker uses.
findings.actual: Totals unchanged (8 and 10); map tile of Starpoint still draws 3/1. Only payments see 5.
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/SummaryBar.tsx:16-17 calls readyResources/readyInfluence(state, pack) without the PayView, so no component modifier (planetResources/planetInfluence) is applied; src/domain/payment.ts:50-57 only applies them when a view is given. Screenshots 35-r4-nanoforge.png; spec step in tests/scenarios/saar.spec.ts (asserts the actual behaviour, '// BUG').

findings.title: First landing on Mecatol Rex gives 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0' with no way to pay it
findings.repro: Round 2: tactical action, active system Mecatol Rex, route 27 > 40 > 18, carrier + 2 infantry, land them. The landing block shows two warnings; there is no payment block anywhere in the editor.
findings.expected: LRR 27.2: removing the custodians token costs 6 influence, so the player must be able to record the payment (the planets/trade goods exhausted) and the shortInfluence warning should then clear. The first text itself says 'which the plan does not record'.
findings.actual: 'The custodians token is still on Mecatol Rex: removing it costs 6 influence, which the plan does not record' plus 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6.' stay on the entry for good (orange edge on the plan row); the 6 influence is not subtracted from the totals either.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:86 hard-codes paid: 0 in the shortInfluence violation; src/ui/plan/editors/TacticalEditor.tsx:225 shows PaymentBlock only when production cost > 0. src/domain/rules/lrr/027-custodians-token.test.ts even tests a 'payment' that the UI cannot enter. Screenshot 13-r2-sol-cards.png (warnings visible behind the drawer).

findings.title: Rowl Sarrig (commander) waiver can never fire; infantry on Ragh is always warned

Warning 'Ragh has no space dock of yours that produces: ground forces go to the planet with the dock.' is shown unstruck, no 'Allowed by: Rowl Sarrig'.
findings.expected: Commander: 'When you produce fighters or infantry: You may place each of those units at any of your space docks that are not blockaded.' Also Saar faction ruling, Floating Factory note 2: ground forces produced by a Floating Factory may be placed on any planet the Saar player controls in that system, so for Saar this warning is not a violation at all.

findings.title: After turning Thunder's Edge on in an open game the component picker does not find the TE breakthroughs

Plan: Add round, Manual adjustment > + Took, search 'deorbit' (also 'auto-factories'); a TE technology ('executive order') is found, the breakthroughs are not. Control: the same game opened by link with exp=pok,te finds 'Deorbit Barrage' (1 hit).

findings.title: Production cost in the editor and shop ignores Sarween Tools and Regulated Conscription: three different costs for one production
findings.repro: Research Sarween Tools (Technology primary, round 1). Pass Regulated Conscription as an agenda entry (round 3). Round 4: tactical action at Acheron (54), Production, buy 9 Infantry, close the shop. Compare the payment block, the shop footer and the warning.
findings.expected: Sarween Tools: lower the combined cost of a production by 1. Regulated Conscription (For): fighters and infantry cost the full price each. 9 infantry = 9 - 1 = 8 resources, one number everywhere, and the auto payment should pay 8.
findings.actual: The payment block says 'Cost 9, paid 4'. The domain warning says 'need 8, paid 4, short by 4'. The shop footer says 'Cost / resources available 5 / 4' and the infantry tiles still show a cost of half. The shop also ignores the law. Auto payment overpays by 1 with no 'Surplus' note: round 2 'Cost 7, paid 7' for dreadnought + 6 fighters (needs 6), and the round 5 flagship costs 8, paid 8, so trade goods fall 7 to 5 where 6 is right.
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/editors/TacticalEditor.tsx:75 (priceOf uses productionCost, while the domain uses costOf in src/domain/replay/production.ts:236); screenshots test-results/scenarios/cabal/35-shop4.png and 36-prod4.png; spec step 'round 5: the flagship is built'

findings.title: The warning for the second use of an exhausted agent (or a component not held) is lost in the Pass editor
findings.repro: Round 2: component action Plagiarize, + Used, The Stillness of Stars. Then add Pass, + Used, The Stillness of Stars again. Look at the Pass editor, then at the plan list.
findings.expected: The warning 'The Stillness of Stars is exhausted: it is readied only in the status phase' stands in the editor of the entry that uses it. Per CLAUDE.md, a warning whose block is not on screen stands at the top of the editor.
findings.actual: The plan list row shows the warning, but the Pass editor shows no warning anywhere (screenshot 19-agent-twice.png).
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/editors/TurnEditor.tsx:71: placer.at('component') takes the component warnings out of rest(), and they are rendered only inside the entry.type === 'component' branch, so a pass loses them. The spec keeps an assert of the empty list with a BUG comment in step 'round 2: the agent is used in a pass...'

covered: Created a 4-player game (Mahact, Sol, Last Bastion, Hacan; PoK and TE on) from the first screen. Pasted a Milty map; start totals Res 3 / Inf 5 / Tactic 3 / Fleet 3 / Strategy 2 matched Ixth 3/5.

Four rounds with about 35 entries of mine. Strategy cards (Technology, Imperial, Trade, Construction, Leadership), tactical actions with transport and a pick-up on the way (Sem-Lore, Mecatol, New Albion), space combat losses, production with payment by planets and trade goods, component actions, passes, status entries, agendas. Totals checked after each round: R3 end Res 4 / Inf 11 / TG 2 / Tactic 4 / Fleet 7 / VP 4, R4 end Res 8 / Inf 13 / Commodities 1 / Tactic 3 / Fleet 8 / VP 6.
Edict: shown as a reminder in the battle step; the fleet-pool token entered by hand through a manual adjustment (Fleet +1).
Imperia: waives the componentNotHeld warning for Sol's unlocked commander Claire Gibson, shown struck through with 'Allowed by: Imperia'.
Hubris: my own Alliance starts out of the game; an Alliance received through my own entry warns; the same note handed over by a rival entry does not warn (finding).
Both faction technologies: Genetic Recombination researched free through the Technology card; Crimson Legionnaire II needs biotic x2 and warns when only one biotic stands.
Agent Jae Mir Kan: used in Politics secondary, the strategy token is spared (Strategy 2 stays), the drawer shows it exhausted, a second use warns 'exhausted', readied at the next round.

Commander Il Na Viroset: unlocked by hand, used in a tactical action onto Mecatol with my own token; the systemHasToken warning is shown struck through with 'Allowed by: Il Na Viroset'; Tactic 1 -> 0.
Hero Airo Shir Aur: unlocked by hand, component action with From and To systems, the cruiser moved from Sem-Lore to Wellon, the hero purged, a second use warns 'you do not hold this component'.

Mech Starlancer: bought in the shop on Ixth (cost 2); the reminder stands at the activation step. Flagship Arvicon Rex: stats and text in the unit list of the drawer, cost 8, capacity 3, combat 5x2, move 1.

Breakthrough Vaults of the Heir: added in the drawer, component action with Heart of Ixth taken and Neural Motivator discarded; the relic shows in the drawer, the breakthrough is exhausted, a second use warns.

Promissory note Scepter of Dominion: given to Sol in a transaction (the drawer shows it in 'Notes of other players' for Sol, with the neighbour warning), played by Sol through Used, returns to my hand (69.3).
Home system: starting units and technologies Predictive Intelligence and Bio-Stims, commodities 3 (0 at the start, 3 after the Trade primary, 1 after giving 2 to Hacan).

General components: techs of all colours (Plasma Scoring red, Cruiser II unit upgrade, Neural Motivator green, Bio-Stims, Predictive Intelligence), action cards (Sabotage, Mining Initiative as a component action, Upgrade in Used with the cruiser turned into a dreadnought, Unexpected Action as a component action removing my token, Skilled Retreat, Direct Hit), relic Heart of Ixth, 3 public objectives scored, laws Holy Planet of Ixth (VP, production 0 warned) and Wormhole Reconstruction.

Rival actions: Sol tactical action takes Sem-Lore (my Res 3 -> 0 and Inf 2 -> 0, structures lost), Sol Warfare and pass with a deal, Hacan component action (my totals unchanged), Sol plays the Scepter.

Leadership primary with 2 bought tokens paid by Mecatol (6 influence) automatically. Russian interface switch checked for untranslated keys (none) and a screenshot. 26 screenshots taken, a dozen looked at. No page or console errors.

findings.title: Sarween Tools is not applied to the cost label, the shop counter and the automatic payment
findings.repro: Hold Sarween Tools (drawer: add it). Tactical action on 92, Production, buy Mech + Infantry on Ordinian (cost 3). The editor shows 'Cost 3, paid 3' (New Albion 1, Revelation 1, Trade goods 1) and the shop 'Cost / resources available 3 / 5'. Later: buy Carrier + Mech (5): 'Cost 5, paid 5' with 3 trade goods. A flagship alone (8) is warned as 'need 7' but the shop says 8 / 6.
findings.expected: Sarween Tools: 'reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1' (LRR production, Sarween ruling): cost 2, resulting trade goods 3 after round 1 e3.
findings.actual: Cost shown and auto payment are the printed sum; only the shortage check uses the reduced value, so the totals lose 1 trade good per production (TG 2 instead of 3).
findings.evidence: src/domain/tactical.ts:180-181 and src/ui/map/stage/useStage.ts:348 call the raw productionCost (unitStats), while the reduced costOf is at src/domain/replay/production.ts:245-251 and is used only in payProduction. Spec: mismatches 'e3 totals', 'r2e4 totals (Sarween: cost 4)'. Hacan scenario shows the same.

findings.title: Helios V2 +2 resources on Ordinian is missing in the Resources summary and in the shop, but counted by the payment block
findings.repro: Research 4X41C Helios V2 in round 3 (Scanlink + Sarween as cybernetic). Look at the top Resources total at the start of round 4 or at the end of round 5: Ordinian (0/0, holds the dock) adds 0. Then open Production: 'resources available' also omits it. The payment block of the same action pays with 'Ordinian 2'.
findings.expected: Card text: 'The resource value of this planet is increased by 2': round 4 start Resources 9 (Revelation 1, New Albion 1, Starpoint 3, Quann 2, Ordinian 2); round 5 end 12.
findings.actual: Round 3 after the research 1 (expected 3), round 4 start 7 (expected 9), round 5 end 10 (expected 12); shop 'resources available' 12 instead of 14 at round 5; yet after the first paying entry of the round the total includes the bonus (R4 after AMD payment shows 3 = 9-6).
findings.evidence: src/domain/payment.ts:53-57 planetValue returns the printed value when no `view` is given; readyResources (src/domain/replay/payment.ts:10) and the shop are called without it. Spec mismatches 'r3e1 totals', 'r4 start'.

Home and start: tile 96 Cronos 2/1 + Tallin 1/2 gives Resources 3, Influence 3, Tactic 3, Fleet 3, Strategy 2. Start tech Sarween Tools added through the drawer.

Strategy cards. Trade primary (rounds 1 and 4): +3 trade goods and commodities replenished to the faction value 3. Trade secondary (round 2). Technology primary (rounds 2 and 3) and secondary (rounds 1 and 5). Imperial primary with Mecatol held: +1 VP.

Technology research with prerequisites. Neural Parasite warns '1 missing (biotic x1)' while listed before Psychoarchaeology, and is clean once reordered. Planesplitter warns '1 missing (cybernetic x1)' before Scanlink, clean after it. Payments are 4 and 6 as expected. Infantry II (two biotic) is researched without a warning. Faction pieces. Both abilities are visible and show as hints (Plots Within Plots in the status step, Puppets of the Blade in the component step). Both faction technologies are researched. The Sowing is added in the drawer and its hint shows in the status step. The mech Viper EX-23 is built; its hint shows in the landing step. Heaven's Eye is built (cost 8, capacity 3) and moved. Myru Vos waives routeBlocked through Sol's ships: the line is struck through with 'Allowed by: Myru Vos'. A second use in the same round warns 'is exhausted', and it is readied again by the status phase. Captain Aroz is unlocked in the drawer and played in Used. Sharsiss is unlocked and played as a component action: the drawer shows Purged and a second play warns 'you do not hold this component'. Black Ops is given to Sol: purged and out of the game, and Sol received 2 trade goods (shown by a later 'need 3, have 2' check).

Deals every round. Trade goods and commodities with Sol. Notes both ways: my Black Ops and Ceasefire, Sol's Support for the Throne, Hacan's Political Secret, Letnev's Ceasefire, Argent's Trade Agreement. Hacan plays my Ceasefire and it returns to me. Board play. Tactical actions with pick-ups from the source, landing on Vefut II and then Mecatol Rex, space combat losses, a carrier route with the speedShort warning, production of a mech and two infantry, production of the flagship. Mecatol landing gives +1 VP.

General. 8 action cards taken, 3 played as component actions and 2 in Used. Relic Shard of the Throne gives +1 VP. Public and secret objectives scored (warning 'scored without its requirement 1 of 6' and '1 of 2'). Law Fleet Regulations from an agenda entry with Mecatol held, shown in the drawer. Tokens distributed in each status phase.
Console and page errors: none during the whole game (checkProblems after each round).

findings.title: Receiving another player's Support for the Throne while holding my own copy gives 2 VP
findings.repro: New game as Firmament. Round 1, tactical action to 20. In the turn open + Transaction, with Sol, Get + Component 'Support for the Throne' (Sol). The VP in the top bar goes 0 -> 2. Add my own 'Support for the Throne' to Give in the same deal and the total becomes 1.
findings.expected: Promissory note text: 'When you receive this card, if you are not the <color> player ... gain 1 victory point'. One received card means +1 VP.
findings.actual: VP 0 -> 2 with my own copy still in hand; with my own copy given away in the same deal it is +1. The effect runs once per held instance of the same base id.
findings.evidence: Spec round 1, step e3 (the 'BUG: receiving Sol's Support for the Throne gives 2 points' assertion). Cause: src/domain/effects/registry.ts:181-187 (inForceOf keeps every instance id: promissory:<color>_sftt@me and @sol) and src/domain/replay/acts.ts:80-86 (dealt is called once per in-force id with the same got goods; color_sftt.ts:44-48 adds +1 each time).

findings.title: Sarween Tools does not lower the production cost shown or paid (shop, payment block, totals)
findings.repro: Start tech Sarween Tools (drawer, Technologies, Add). Round 1, tactical action on home 96, Production: Mech + 2 Infantry (2 + 1). The shop says 'Cost / resources available 3 / 4', the Payment block says 'Cost 3, paid 3' and 3 trade goods are taken (1 left of 4). Round 4: Heaven's Eye shows 'Cost 8, paid 8'.
findings.expected: Sarween Tools card: 'reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1' while a unit with PRODUCTION is used: 2 for the mech and two infantry, 7 for the flagship. The home dock produces.
findings.actual: Full cost, no reduction. The effect file technology/st.ts defines modify productionCost, but the amount seeded into the payment and the shop counter ignore it. The same defect was reported in the Hacan game.
findings.evidence: Spec round 1 e5 (assertion 'Cost 3, paid 3' and trade goods 1 afterwards), round 4 r4-e3. Probable cause src/domain/tactical.ts:180-181 (withProduction seeds the payment from productionCost() without the 'productionCost' point of src/domain/replay/production.ts:245-251).

findings.title: A battle loss of another player's unit recorded in a later entry removes that unit from earlier entries: neighbour warning appears, and Support for the Throne no longer returns
findings.repro: A) Setup on tile 50: a Destroyer of each rival. Entry 1: tactical action with a transaction with Hacan: no warning. Later entry 2: tactical action to 50, Battle, tap the Hacan Destroyer as lost. Entry 1 now shows 'A transaction is only with a neighbour'. B) Hold Sol's Support for the Throne (VP 3), activate 50 where Sol's Destroyer stands and in the same entry mark Sol's Destroyer as lost: the note does not return and the VP stays 3; without marking the loss the VP drops to 2 as it should.
findings.expected: Losses of the combat happen after activation: the card text 'When you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the <color> player's units' is met at the moment of activation, and an earlier entry must not change because of a later one.
findings.actual: Rival losses are written to the board for the whole plan, so they take effect at the start of earlier entries and before the activation-time checks.
findings.evidence: Spec round 2 e4 and e5 (the loss of the Sol Destroyer was removed from e5 so the game goes on; status of round 2 listing shows the neighbour warning on tactical action 78); notes lines AFTER-T50 and STATUS-R2. Cause area: src/domain/effects/components/promissory/color_sftt.ts:19-25 reads turn.states[owner] after rival losses are applied. The Ghost game found the related 'loss stays after entry delete'.

findings.title: Fabrication (and Black Market Forgery) fragment purge warns 'Not enough relic fragments' because the fragment's own 3-fragment rule is applied

findings.title: Exploration attachment (Lazax Survivors) is missing from the summary totals, tile badge and shop counter, but counted in payment
findings.repro: New game as Argent, Prophecy of Kings. Tactical action: take Lodor and Hope's End; in the entry add + Took > Lazax Survivors (attaches to Hope's End). Start round 2 and read the summary Resources and Influence in Forecast. Also open a Production shop at home with a 10-resource purchase and read 'Cost / resources available'.
findings.expected: Lazax Survivors: 'This planet's resource value is increased by 1 and its influence value is increased by 2'. Hope's End 3/0 becomes 4/2, so round 2 start should show Resources 10 and Influence 6 (Valk 2 + Avar 1 + Lodor 3 + Hope's End 4; Ylir 2 + Avar 1 + Lodor 1 + Hope's End 2).
findings.actual: Summary shows 9 and 4; the map tile badge still reads Hope's End 3/0; the shop counter says 'Cost / resources available 10 / 9' while the Payment block of the same entry says 'Cost 10, paid 10' using 'Hope's End 4'; a Leadership purchase paid 'Hope's End 2, Avar 1' for influence (so payment counts the card, the summary does not).
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/SummaryBar.tsx:16-17 calls readyResources/readyInfluence(state, pack) without a PayView, so planetValue (src/domain/payment.ts:48-58) returns printed values; same in src/ui/map/stage/useStage.ts:349. Screenshot 55-shop-lodor.png, 14-round2.png. Spec asserts actual numbers with // BUG comments.

findings.title: Payment stays in the entry after the thing it paid for is removed
findings.repro: Round 1, Strategy entry Technology primary. Research Aerie Hololattice, then + second technology Strike Wing Alpha II (payment block appears, Valk and Avar exhausted). Press 'Remove Strike Wing Alpha II'. Read the summary in Forecast.
findings.expected: Nothing left to pay: Resources 3 and Influence 3 (planets ready).
findings.actual: Payment block disappears but the summary stays at Resources 0, Influence 2 (Valk and Avar still exhausted) until the whole action is removed and recreated. (A Leadership purchase removed with 'Remove one Tactic' recovers after a moment, so that path is fine.)
findings.evidence: Spec step 'strategy: Technology primary, Aerie Hololattice free' asserts the stale 0/2 with a // BUG comment. Cause not located.

findings.title: Production editor quotes the price without the Sarween Tools combined reduction while the replay applies it
findings.repro: Round 1: have Sarween Tools. Tactical action at home 58, Production: Destroyer, 2 Infantry (Valk), 2 Fighters (units cost 1 + 1 + 1 = 3). Read the Payment block.
findings.expected: Sarween Tools takes 1 off the combined cost: cost 2, paid by Valk alone.
findings.actual: Payment block says 'Cost 3, paid 3' and exhausts Valk and Avar; the summary after the entry is Resources 0, Influence 2 where Valk alone would leave Avar's 1/1.
findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/editors/TacticalEditor.tsx:75 uses productionCost (unit prices); src/domain/replay/production.ts:245 costOf takes Sarween into account, so the two disagree. Asserted in the spec with // BUG.

findings.title: Taking Mecatol Rex always warns 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6', and there is no place to pay
findings.repro: Round 3: Tactical action to Mecatol Rex (18) from Hope's End with 2 infantry on destroyers, land both on Mecatol Rex while influence is ready (forecast Influence 4 or more).
findings.expected: LRR 27.2: the custodians token is removed by spending 6 influence; the entry should offer a payment (planets / trade goods) and clear the warning when paid, and the influence should drop in the forecast.
findings.actual: Two warnings stand: 'The custodians token is still on Mecatol Rex: removing it costs 6 influence, which the plan does not record; ...' and 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6', regardless of what is ready. The tactical editor has no payment block for it, so the warning cannot be cleared and the forecast influence is never reduced (12 at round 3 end including Mecatol's 6 that were not spent).
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:84-89 pushes shortInfluence with paid: 0 constant. The LRR test src/domain/rules/lrr/027-custodians-token.test.ts has a payment parameter that is unused.

covered: Game created through the first screen: 6 players (Titans, Argent, Hacan, Xxcha, Jol-Nar, Muaat), Prophecy of Kings on and Thunder's Edge off, Milty map pasted, empty slots filled by tile number, game started. Start totals checked (4/1, tactic 3, fleet 3, strategy 2).

4 rounds, 30 plan entries of mine (R1 5, R2 8, R3 13 with one Argent entry, R4 4) plus the copy plan's extra entries. Every round has a strategy card, tactical actions, component actions, a pass and a status entry; an agenda entry with Mecatol taken in R3.
Totals checked in forecast and now mode after each round (resources, influence, trade goods, commodities, tactic, fleet, strategy, VP); computed by hand from the rules and the data.

Strategy cards: Technology primary (free first, 6 for the second), Technology secondary (1 token + 4), Trade primary (+3 TG, commodities 0 to 2 = Titans value) with free-secondary players, Construction secondary (PDS at Lodor, pre-TE token left in the system and the 'cannot be activated again' warning). Prerequisite warning of Saturn Engine II without biotic and the 'at most 2' warning checked.

Faction technologies: Hel-Titan II researched via Technology secondary (PDS upgrade, production 1 at Lodor: 'Production 1, and 2 units are built' warning, one unit clean; structure aboard warning when the PDS is taken); Saturn Engine II (cruiser capacity 2: cargo 3 of 5 with 2 cruisers + dreadnought). Starting techs Antimass Deflectors and Scanlink Drone Network seen in drawer and players sheet.

Faction abilities Terragenesis, Awaken, Coalescence: shown as reminders in the activation, combat and invasion blocks (hints, as designed). Tellurian agent: used in a battle (hit cancelled, loss given back, capacity warning gone), exhausted state in the drawer, second use warns (list entry, tactical editor). Tungstantus commander: unlocked by hand, 'Used' on a production entry gives +1 TG (twice). Ul the Progenitor hero: unlocked by hand, component action readies Elysium and attaches +3/+3 (payment pays Elysium 7, production limit 9 at the dock), purged afterwards, second play warns 'you do not hold this component'.

Flagship Ouranos built (cost 8, paid Elysium 7 + 1 TG; fleet pool 5 of 4 warning and the excess-ships removal). Hecatoncheires mech produced in the shop (4 mechs + infantry, production limit 9 with the hero). Home specifics: Elysium 4/1, start units, commodities 2, no off-map home.

General components: technologies Plasma Scoring (red), Neural Motivator (green), Dark Energy Tap (blue), Dreadnought II (unit upgrade, move 2 shown by the flight check); 7 action cards taken and Uprising (with the condition warning, then lawful after Argent takes Ang by hand), Summit (+2 tactic), Mining Initiative, Rise of a Messiah (infantry on every planet), played as component actions, Upgrade played in 'Used' (cruiser becomes dreadnought); hand limit warning at 8 cards; relic Dynamis Core (+4 TG) played; public objective Negotiate Trade Routes scored (5 TG paid), Diversify Research and Erect a Monument scored short with the warning; law Anti-Intellectual Revolution passed and listed in the drawer.

Movement and combat: route with transport and pick-up from a planet, space battle with losses of both sides entered in the battle stage, landing on Hope's End and Mecatol (custodians warnings, +1 VP), speed warning for the flagship on a two-step route.
Twist: copy plan; the copy was changed (a tactical entry deleted, renamed) and the original stayed the same; a change of the original (pass deleted) did not reach the copy.
Thunder's Edge link game: Slumberstate Computing is added in the drawer (starts as 'none') and its reminder stands in the landing block.
Console errors watched on every step (pageerror and console.error): none. 40+ screenshots in test-results/scenarios/titans, about 15 of them looked at.

findings.evidence: src/ui/plan/SummaryBar.tsx:16-17 calls readyResources(state, pack) without the PayView; src/ui/map/stage/useStage.ts:349 readyResources(payer, pack) likewise; the working path is planetValue(..., view) in src/domain/payment.ts:46. findings.title: A Pass editor does not show the 'is exhausted' warning of a component named in 'Used'
findings.repro: R2: use Tellurian in the tactical action at Hope's End, then Add action > Pass > '+ Used' > Tellurian.

findings.title: Taking Mecatol Rex always warns 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0' and the editor has no place to pay it
findings.repro: R3 tactical action to Mecatol Rex (flight from Hope's End), land 3 infantry. Read the Landing block.
findings.expected: LRR 54.1/27.2: 6 influence to remove the custodians token; the plan should let the player pay it, or at least not claim 'paid 0' when influence is available (Titans had 8 influence ready in R4 terms).
findings.actual: Two warnings: 'The custodians token is still on Mecatol Rex: removing it costs 6 influence, which the plan does not record; the first to land gains 1 victory point.' and 'Not enough influence: need 6, paid 0, short by 6.'. There is no Payment block in the editor, so the second one can never be cleared; the first text contradicts the second. VP does go 1 to 2.
findings.evidence: src/domain/replay/invasion.ts:86 pushes shortInfluence {needed: 6, paid: 0} unconditionally. Screenshot 28-mecatol.png, dump mecatol-2.

covered: First screen: 6 players (Ral Nel, Hacan, Sol, Argent, Naalu, Mentak), PoK and TE on; three tiles typed by hand, switched to Large Galaxy and back (hand tiles kept), Milty string pasted over them (Replace map confirm), Copy link read from the clipboard, the link opened in a fresh browser context recreated the game and map, then Start.
Start numbers checked: Mez 2/1 + Rep 1/3 = 3 resources, 4 influence, 3/3/2 tokens, commodities 4 after Trade; start units on tile 93 including the space dock.

Round 1: Technology main (Nanomachines with warfare from the Plasma Scoring I added in the drawer), Linkship II prerequisites and the 6-resource second research warned; Nanomachines PDS action, second use warns exhausted; tactical with a carrier, 4 infantry and a PDS (Miniaturization: waived structureAboard, cargo stays 4 of 4); battle with losses of mine and of Mentak; production at the dock (fighters over the dock room warn correctly); Kan Kip Rel action with cards taken, second use warns; pass; status with tokens, VP and a card.

Round 2: Trade main (+3 TG, commodities 4), Technology secondary for Linkship II (4 resources + token, Destroyer upgrade disabled afterwards, move 3 to 4 shown), deal with Mentak next to its home (neighbour check holds only with my cruiser at 37), Nano-Link Permit given and played by Mentak (waiver Allowed by Nano-Link Permit, note returns to me per 69.3), production of Linkship II / Alarum mech / carrier with planet and trade-good payment (cost 6), Nanomachines third ability, pass, commander unlocked by hand, status with an objective scored without its requirement (warned 1 of 2).

Round 3: Kan Kip Rel again after readying, deal for a trade good, Technology main Gravity Drive + Sarween Tools (cost 6 paid in full), own-card secondary warned, Mecatol taken with the Dreadnought + infantry (Gravity Drive waives exactly 1 missing step and does not waive 2), custodians warnings, planets taken, hero Director Nel unlocked by hand and played in a Pass (+2 tactic tokens, turn after pass waived), tactical after the pass, second hero play, status with 2 objectives (Expand Borders 4 of 6 warned), law Minister of Commerce through an agenda entry.

Round 4: Trade main with the law (+3 +1 neighbour = 4 TG, correct), flagship Last Dispatch + mech + fighters (cost 11 = 8+2+1, limit 4 respected), Data Skimmer and a relic added in the drawer, Mining Initiative as a component action (+3 TG from Starpoint), pass, Linkship II four-step flight without speed warning, status, reload keeps all totals (now = forecast).

Round 5: Technology main with PDS II (unit upgrade from red + yellow) and Neural Motivator (green, cost 6), action cards in Used (Direct Hit in a battle, Sabotage in a pass); Players drawer sheet of Ral Nel read; Russian interface checked for raw keys.
About 40 plan entries of mine over 5 rounds plus rival entries (Mentak), 25+ screenshots, no page or console errors in the whole run.
